translations.web: Also to you, Lord, belongs loving kindness, for you reward every man according to his work.
translations.bsb: and loving devotion to You, O Lord. For You will repay each man according to his deeds.
translations.kjv: Also unto thee, O Lord, belongeth mercy: for thou renderest to every man according to his work.
translations.asv: Also unto thee, O Lord, belongeth lovingkindness; For thou renderest to every man according to his work. Psalm 63 A Psalm of David when he was in the wilderness of Judah.
